title: GSK Goes Big: The $10.6B Nuvalent Deal Is Not Just a Lung-Cancer Pipeline Buy
summary: GSK's $10.6 billion all-cash acquisition of Nuvalent is more than a late-stage lung-cancer pipeline deal. It is a strategic attempt to rebuild oncology, buy time before major revenue pressure, and regain a seat at the precision-oncology table.
